## About
All Around Automotive started with an old adage: treat people how we would want to be treated. We still believe it's the right practice today. Our philosophy is simple: outstanding personal service and quality repairs, all backed with a strong warranty.
We've moved a couple of times over the years, and our SE Portland shop on Division is where we've become part of the community. We support local organizations, and it's our privilege to help our customers, neighbors and friends with whatever their vehicles throw at them.
We always take the time to explain any recommendations and answer your questions. Our customers have given us a 4.6 rating across 113 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to earn yours.

## Services
- Drivability and Engine Diagnostics: Running rough or showing a warning light? We'll track down what's going on.
- Computer System Analysis and Repair: Diagnosis and repair of your vehicle's onboard computer systems.
- DEQ Certified Repairs: State certified DEQ repairs, with dynamometers for accurate NoX testing.
- Pre-purchase Inspections: Have us look over a car before you buy it.
- Motorvac Carbon Clean System: Carbon cleaning service using the Motorvac system.
- 30/60/90/120/150 Thousand Mile Maintenance Services: Scheduled preventative maintenance at the mileage milestones that matter.
- RV Service: We work on motorhomes too, gas or diesel.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Most makes and models of cars, light trucks, vans and motorhomes, whether gas, diesel or hybrid.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on SE Division in Portland.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open 8 to 5, Monday through Friday, and closed on weekends.

Q: Can you arrange a tow?
A: Yes. Just ask and we'll arrange towing for you.

Q: Is your warranty good outside Portland?
A: We provide a nationwide warranty on most services.
